extraction_notes: Only SI experimental CO2-hydrogenation performance figures were extracted. Characterisation figures S1-S4 and S8-S10 were out of scope. Figure S6 was not extracted because it reports logarithmic reaction-order plots (ln rate vs ln partial pressure) rather than direct formation-rate values suitable for the requested fields. All numeric performance values from SI Figures S5 and S7 are approximate readings from plotted points.
